# FD-Loss provenance

`losses.py` and `queue.py` are complete, byte-for-byte upstream copies of
`frechet_distance/losses.py` and `frechet_distance/queue.py` at this commit.
Local changes to these two files: **none**. Only package `__init__.py` added.
ColorMF orchestration/adapters live in `src/fd_module.py` and are described in
`docs/fd_posttraining.md`. No FD, covariance or square-root implementation added.
